name: Micro-action-52
description: A vision benchmark for recognizing micro-actions from subtle human motion, using whole-body perspective data to classify imperceptible non-verbal behaviors that can inform emotion recognition and psychological assessment.
evaluation_method: Top-1 accuracy, top-k accuracy, macro-F1, and related classification metrics for recognizing micro-action categories.
notes: Targets extremely subtle, low-intensity human behaviors that are difficult to observe and label. The benchmark is paired with MANet in the source description.
